    ⚠️ Sign-in only works when this site is opened over https:// (like GitHub Pages) or on localhost — not by double-clicking the HTML file.

    New here? Signing in creates your kerNEl account automatically. Your name tag, rank and saved stories are kept in this browser.

    🛠️ Site owner: sign-in isn’t switched on yet
    1. Google: create an OAuth Client ID (type “Web application”) in Google Cloud Console, add this site’s origin to “Authorized JavaScript origins”, then paste the ID into the CONFIG section near the top of the script in index.html.
    2. Apple: create a Services ID with “Sign in with Apple” on developer.apple.com, add this domain and return URL, then paste it into the CONFIG section near the top of the script in index.html.

    Full step-by-step guide in the project’s README.md.
